Hi! I’d like some help with a few recent orders. I need to exchange a helmet for a different size and style, swap out a luggage set from another order, and also modify a grill order I just placed. Can you assist me with these?

Yes—I can help, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please reply with **the email address** associated with your orders (or, if you prefer, **first name + last name + ZIP code**).

Also, when you can, include:
1) The **order ID** for the **helmet exchange**
2) The **order ID** for the **luggage set swap** (and whether that order is already **delivered**)
3) The **order ID** for the **grill modification** (it must be **pending** for changes)

I actually don’t remember the email address I used, but my name is Sofia Hernandez and my ZIP code is 98193 in Seattle, WA.

I’ll need to look up the order numbers—could you help me find them if I give you some details about the items or dates?
sofia_hernandez_5364

Thanks, Sofia—I've found your account: **sofia_hernandez_5364**.

Yes, I can help look up your order IDs, but I’ll need a bit of detail. Please tell me:

1) **Helmet exchange**: approximate **order date** (or the date you received it), and any of the following if you have them:
   - helmet brand/model or the **size** you want
   - last 4 digits of the order total (optional), or anything shown on the order/receipt

2) **Luggage set swap**: approximate **order date**, and confirm whether that luggage order is **already delivered** (if you know).

3) **Grill modification**: the **date you placed the order** (it must be **pending** for item modifications).

If you don’t know the exact dates, just give approximate windows like “early July” / “within the last 2 weeks,” and I’ll use that to identify the right orders from your order history.

Sure! Here’s what I remember:

1) For the helmet, I ordered it about three weeks ago and received it roughly two weeks back. I want to exchange it for a medium, red, high ventilation type. I don’t recall the brand or order total, but it was the only helmet I ordered recently.

2) The luggage set was ordered around late May, and yes, it has already been delivered. I’d like to swap it for a two-piece, black, soft material set.

3) The grill order was just placed yesterday, so it should still be pending. I want to modify it to match the same type as the grill I already received.

Let me know if you need any more details!
